newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Fiat dealer boosts sales.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Fiat dealer boosts sales.

text.p: Zadarkomerc, Croatian representative for the Italian carmaker Fiat, said booming sales had made Fiat the second best-selling cars in Croatia, Vecernji List daily said on Wednesday.
In the first three months of 1997 Zadarkomerc sold 3,000 cars, mostly through favourable credit lines with local banks, boosting Fiat's market share in Croatia to more than 20 percent.
"This year our plan is to sell 8,000 cars," the paper quoted Zadarkomerc's owner Ante Jurjevic as saying.
Based in the Adriatic port of Zadar, Zadarkomerc became Fiat's representative for Croatia in April 1996 when the Italian carmaker held ninth place in car sales.
It sold over 3,500 Fiat cars in the second half of 1996 and opened shops in the five biggest cities, the daily said.
Zadarkomerc is also Croatia's biggest rent-a-car company.
